sources.author: BlazeFTL
patch_list: Boost Splash Screen Time
Dont Apply These Patches Over Some Other Persons Mod, Use Untouched Apk. Disables MX Player's welcome/splash ad so playback starts immediately. Also removes startup network calls and the splash logo.
Clean Me Tab
Adds Mod Settings switches, on by default, that hide promo rows, unused tiles, and Private Folder / File Transfer / Add to Playlist entries.
Configure Smart Enhance
Removes the Smart Enhance disable toast and adds Mod Settings switches for the intro popup and the enable toast.
Configure SpeedUp overlay
Fixes the stock leftover-visible-view bug in the long-press SpeedUp overlay. "No UI" is toggled in Me tab > Mod Settings.
Disable Bottom Bar And Add Me Tab To Top

Adds a permanent Me tab button to the toolbar. Hiding the bottom bar itself is toggled live in Me tab > Mod Settings, not here - the Me tab button always stays wired, on purpose, since Mod Settings lives behind it and turning it off should…
Kill Signature Verification
Patches libmx-bh.so to kill signature verification.
Remove Recycle Bin

Deleted files are always removed permanently, whenever this patch is applied - there's no safe way to make that half a runtime switch without the stock (unpatched) delete-dialog code to fall back to. The Me tab tile itself is a Mod Setting…
Replace FFmpeg codec

Replaces libffmpeg.mx.so in every lib/<abi>/ folder present in the APK with the matching file from a selected codec zip (EAC3 support). neon64 -> arm64-v8a, neon -> armeabi-v7a, x86 -> x86, x86_64 -> x86_64. ABI folders missing from the AP…
Sidebar & Player Defaults

Cleans the player sidebar and More menu; sets default shortcuts and subtitle view. Configurable in Mod Settings, except the default shortcuts bitmask, still a Morphe option pending its Mod Settings move.
Smart Enhance Always On
Applies Smart Enhance to every video at a level set in Mod Settings, and keeps it after lock/unlock.
Smart Enhance Slider
Replaces the Smart Enhance toggle with a 0-100% popup slider and keeps the level after lock/unlock.

patch_list: Clean Me page
Removes the Status Saver, Legal, and Help sections from the Me page while keeping the 8-item local tools grid, App Theme, Settings, and Custom Pop-up Play.
Custom codec

Bundles an MX Player v3.1.0 custom codec (aio-v3.1.0_r1.zip, architecture ZIP, or libffmpeg.mx.so*) directly into the app for out-of-the-box E-AC-3, TrueHD, MLP, DTS, and AC-3 software audio decoding.
Remove ads & bloat

Removes banner, folder, player, interstitial, rewarded, app-open, exit, and Me-page ads, removes the Home horizontal shortcut strip and online Zodiac App Themes, and disables Live TV, mxplay OTT streaming, MX Tube, Shorts, and Games while…
Remove bottom navigation bar
Removes the bottom navigation bar from the UI and moves Me to the upper-right corner of the Home toolbar. Leave unchecked to keep the bottom navigation bar.
